description: Defines utilities for JSON-RPC direct linking and security token retrieval within the WPEFramework Utils namespace, including class JSONRPCDirectLink and function GetThunderSecurityToken.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Handles JSON-RPC communication with a specified controller, including serialization/deserialization of parameters and responses.

methods.name: GetThunderSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token from the security agent via the provided service interface.

methods.name: JSONRPCDirectLink::FromString
methods.description: Deserializes response string into JSON element.

methods.name: JSONRPCDirectLink::Invoke
methods.description: Performs a JSON-RPC call with specified method and parameters, and processes the response.

methods.name: GetThunderControllerClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a JSONRPCDirectLink instance, managing security token acquisition.
